# Durable Playbooks

Turn repeated wins into short reusable patterns kept outside chat scrollback.

## Structure

One entry per failure class: symptom fingerprint, fastest isolation check, fix pattern, verification.

## Prune aggressively

Delete playbooks that no longer match the system; stale recipes cause confident wrong fixes.

## Link to evidence

Reference passing commands or log lines, not vibes.
